Name: Glasshand
Tagline: Give your agent a real iPhone and Mac
Description: Glasshand gives your AI agents real iPhones and Macs to work on. Connect Claude Code, Codex, or any other agent, and it can rent a device with a single prompt. The hardware sits in our data center, and your agent uses it the way you would: posting on TikTok, booking an Uber, or building and testing iOS apps. Each device is yours alone for as long as you rent it. When you’re done, we erase your data and factory-reset it.

Name: Living Brain
Tagline: Interoperable, efficient memory layer for agentic AI
Description: Every AI conversation contains knowledge worth keeping, but most of it gets trapped in separate chats and tools. Living Brain captures that knowledge, connects it to what you already know, and turns it into a persistent memory that keeps evolving. Share that intelligence across AI models, apps, and agents through API, SDK, or MCP, so every new interaction builds on the last instead of starting over. Reuse memory across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, OpenClaw, Hermes, Cursor, Codex and more

Name: ChatGPT Images 2.6
Tagline: GIFs, reusable reference images and 50% faster generation
Description: ChatGPT Images 2.6 is OpenAI's latest image model in ChatGPT, Codex and the API. Turn a prompt or image into an animated GIF, adjust its speed and edit frames. Save reference images of yourself, pets or characters and reuse them anytime. Generation is 50% faster, with stronger consistency across edits. Developers get GPT-Image-2.6 Flare (as fast as six seconds) and Sunburst (higher quality), plus image markup and SVG export.

Name: Clocknext
Tagline: Pricing and Billing Infrastructure for AI Agents
Description: Clocknext is a billing and monetization platform for AI-native apps and agents. It’s tailored for AI founders, revenue, and engineering teams, to track AI usage from your product in real time, turn it into billable metrics with flexible pricing plans, and monitor costs, margins, and profitability at every level.

Name: Pushary for Teams
Tagline: See who said yes to your team’s AI agents
Description: When an AI agent stops to ask permission, Pushary sends the question to the person running it, in their Mac’s notch or on their phone. Lee’s agent asks Lee. Sam’s agent asks Sam. A rule can send a push to your infra repo to your lead instead. Answers from the phone, Mac app and dashboard are saved with a name, so when something breaks, one page shows whose agent asked and who said yes. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Agy and Hermes.

Name: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe
Tagline: Intelligent Transcription with a Speech LLM
Description: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe is an open speech LLM for intelligent transcription: a single model that transcribes 40 languages verbatim or in written form, with context, speaker attribution, and word timestamps, selected with a natural language instruction. It is the best open-weights model on the English and multilingual Open ASR Leaderboards.

Name: TextKit
Tagline: Send + receive texts in the US and Canada with a simple API
Description: One API to send and receive texts, verify phone numbers and buy local or toll-free numbers in the US and Canada. Test mode runs every call without texting real people. We file your 10DLC registration. SDKs, a CLI and an MCP server. Per text costs of TextKit are half or less of the base rate at the big SMS APIs. A simple SMS api that just works. Integrates in 100+ services including claude and chatGPT. AI-assisted campaign registrations. Human support. Also - 50% cheaper than Twilio

Name: Polylane for Google Cloud
Tagline: An AI on-call engineer for your Google Cloud apps
Description: Ship with confidence on Google Cloud. Polylane investigates issues in your apps, shows you what went wrong and what it affects, and prepares a fix for you to review. Get answers without digging through logs and dashboards, so you can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Name: Pinku
Tagline: Private AI chat that runs offline on your iPhone and Mac
Description: Pinku runs open models (Llama, Qwen, Gemma) on your iPhone, iPad and Mac with Apple's MLX. Download a model once and chat offline, even in airplane mode. No account, no server: your chats never leave your device. Free to start.

Name: Zerg Client
Tagline: The coding agent harness that drives its own terminal panes
Topics: Software Engineering, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: Zerg AI's own coding harness, in evaluation beta. Ask for Vim or htop and the agent opens them in panes beside it. Panes can hold more agents, each on its own model. Available models depend on your sign-in route and provider access. Mac with Apple chips.

Name: Tao Browser
Tagline: Private browser with a separate login for every company
Description: Tao Browser keeps each company, client or project in its own space with its own cookies and logins. Lock tabs with Face ID or Touch ID, block ads and trackers on your device, import from Arc. No account, no telemetry. Free on iPhone, iPad and Mac (beta).

Name: Bridge
Tagline: Video conferencing for the agentic era
Description: This launch marks a new era for Bridge: one agentic meeting platform replacing the fragmented meeting stack. Bridge now brings scheduling pages, automatic preparation, video conferencing, live intelligence, AI notetaking, agentic workflows, and structured memory into one connected experience for people and agents. At the center of this launch is a new kind of video conferencing built for customizable AI agents to join and participant in meetings.

Name: Keel
Tagline: A native macOS client for Redis, Valkey and Dragonfly
Description: Keel is a free, open-source Mac app for Redis 6+, Valkey and Dragonfly. Browse millions of keys with SCAN only, edit every core type, use a redis-cli-style console and read server health. Read-only connections and typed confirmations keep production safe.

Name: Stitch.ai
Tagline: Your new workspace with mail, calendar and tasks built in
Description: Stitch.ai brings mail, calendar, contacts, tasks, notes, sheets, slides, boards, and files into one connected workspace. Stitchy, your AI assistant, works with you across it all. Dual workspace panels allow you to drag, drop, and Stitch anything to everything. Nothing gets lost. AI-powered Knots, Tags, and Connections keep your work organized and easy to surface. Everything is built in: no integrations or extra email clients to set up. Get your work done in one place, without losing context.

Name: FounderMail
Tagline: Mail for you and your agents, on your Cloudflare domain
Description: Real email on the domains you already run on Cloudflare, without paying per seat or forwarding to Gmail. You, your team and your AI agents work from the same inbox, and agents get their own access instead of your password.

Name: Okapi
Tagline: AI agents that fix API breaking changes in your repos
Description: AI agents that fix API breaking changes in your repos. It is built for developers whose apps and agents depend on third-party APIs. These APIs change all the time, and one breaking change can take your app down in production. Okapi keeps your code up to date with every API it calls, so your app keeps working and your team stops chasing changelogs. Okapi works with any API and is 100% free.

Name: Rerun
Tagline: Turn your AI subscriptions into a team of coworkers
Topics: Productivity, Open Source, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Rerun turns your ChatGPT or Claude subscription into a team of AI coworkers. Each one has tools, a computer and a shared workspace, runs on a schedule or a trigger, and asks before risky actions. Now open-source (AGPL v3) and self-hostable.

Name: Bambu Lab H3C
Tagline: Print multi-material projects faster and easier
Description: Bambu Lab H3C is a next-generation 3D printer that makes multi-material printing faster and easier. Its nine-tool Swaptek system switches materials in as little as six seconds, with less filament waste and no repeated loading. Combine colors, rigid and flexible materials, and different nozzle sizes in a single print. With automatic calibration, integrated filament storage and drying, and support for soft TPU, H3C lets you focus on what you're making, not managing your printer.

Name: Maritime
Tagline: Cloud computers for any AI agent, customized your way
Description: Maritime gives AI agents their own cloud computers: persistent workspaces, disposable sandboxes, Linux and Windows desktops, and Android phones. Agents can run code, use browsers, and work in apps without APIs, with a human able to take over when needed. Whether you’re building a personal assistant or running thousands of tasks in parallel, Maritime handles the computers so you can focus on what your agent does.

Name: AI Employees by Easy-Peasy.AI
Tagline: Hire an AI team that splits the work and asks before sending
Description: Hire AI employees by role: a Chief of Staff, analyst, designer, support rep and 15 more, or describe your own. Add your website and the team reads it. Brief everyone in a group chat: the lead splits the work, teammates reply in a thread and you get one write-up. By default, emails, calendar changes and app actions wait for your OK. Each employee has a memory, its own computer and routines that run on a schedule or when an email arrives. You can even call them. Your first employee is free.
